items.title: Q2 Earnings Scorecard: Record Margins, Strong Beats, and Upward Revisions
items.summary: For the 451 S&P 500 companies that have reported Q2 results, aggregate earnings have grown +41.6% YoY on +14.7% higher revenues. Positive surprises are also widespread, with 83.4% beating EPS estimates and 76.5% topping revenue estimates.
